user.title: Connect to PLOUD
user.description: Enter the existing PLOUD access token and the five-character device identifier. This integration does not create or activate a PLOC/PLOUD account.

reconfigure.title: Change PLOUD server
reconfigure.description: Change the base URL used to connect to PLOUD. The device identifier and token will be kept.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with PLOUD
reauth_confirm.description: The PLOUD access token was rejected. Enter a valid token to restore synchronization.

error.invalid_server: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS base URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
error.invalid_token: The access token cannot be empty.
error.invalid_device: The device identifier must contain exactly five characters.

abort.already_configured: This PLOUD device is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The PLOUD access token has been updated.

init.title: Synchronization settings
init.description: Choose how often the cellar is synchronized and the language requested from PLOUD.

get_inventory.name: Get inventory
get_inventory.description: Return the stocked wines and their rack positions without creating entities.

search.name: Search
search.description: Match wine name, appellation, region, country, grape or cuvée.

sync.name: Synchronize
sync.description: Trigger an immediate read-only synchronization with PLOUD.
